note: Preview gallery for ui_gallery: every layout of the PDA as the engine draws it. Page hosts are the container a layout lives in (layout units); migrated rows use the list width minus 10 (the scrollbar), hand-written rows their own root size. A fixture travels to the bridge as one JSON string of at most ~1000 bytes on the wire.

entries.name: shell
entries.note: the device shell with seven tabs in the rail; pages are looked at separately

entries.name: page-map
entries.note: the marker panel open, six rows in it; the fixture hides the map itself, because a MapWidget paints over every neighbour and the panel would be under it in a still

entries.name: page-contacts
entries.note: half-width page; the faction page is its satellite

entries.name: page-chat
entries.note: rows come from the fixture the way the script adds them; heights are the engine's

entries.name: row-marker
entries.note: 323 = the map page's MarkerScroll (333) minus the scrollbar; the row moved into that list with task 35

entries.name: icons
entries.note: every sprite of the set, tinted accent; blank cells = the set is not registered or the texture did not load
